limitations: Metadata labels are conservative regex annotations of incomplete free text.
Cross-context functional analog is an automated signal-coverage flag requiring biological review.
Background distributions use every ARCHS4 sample and therefore reflect ARCHS4 study composition rather than a study-balanced null.

score_definitions.asymmetric_containment_top10: mean query-top10 signed rank containment; extras ignored and sign mismatches penalized by 0.25
score_definitions.query_weighted_top10: absolute-query-weighted signed magnitude agreement on only query top 10; reference/query magnitude ratio capped at one
score_definitions.signed_absolute_rank: cosine of sign(value) times within-sample absolute-rank percentile
score_definitions.signed_topK_overlap: fraction of query top-K absolute Hallmarks also reference top-K with matching sign; cosine breaks ties
score_definitions.whole_vector_cosine: cosine across all 50 signed Hallmark values
